title: Homelab Overview
description: The landing page. Fleet health first, then the node table, then everything else behind the dropdowns in the header.

options.content:
Eight numbers that answer *is anything wrong*. Everything below, and every dashboard in the header dropdowns, is detail behind them.

---

panels.title: Cluster quorum
panels.description: Corosync quorum on Galaxy. Without it Proxmox refuses to start or migrate a guest.

panels.title: Guests running
panels.description: Every VM and container Proxmox reports as running.

panels.title: Services reachable
panels.description: Out of nineteen internal service names, probed end to end through Nginx Proxy Manager.

panels.title: Scrape targets down
panels.description: A target down means a blind spot, not necessarily an outage.

panels.title: UPS on mains
panels.description: Red as soon as either UPS drops off mains.

panels.title: Hottest CPU package
panels.description: The warmest of the five nodes, at the die rather than a core.

targets.expr: max(node_hwmon_temp_celsius{role="hypervisor"} * on (host, chip, sensor) group_left (label) node_hwmon_sensor_label{label=~"Package id 0|Tctl"} * 9 / 5 + 32)

panels.title: Fullest filesystem
panels.description: The single tightest mount anywhere in the fleet.

options.content:
One table, ten health checks, and a row only when something fails one of them. Empty is the goal.

---

panels.title: Anything failing a health check
panels.description: Scrape targets down, services unreachable, certificates inside 21 days, ZFS pools not online, NVMe critical warnings or spare under 10%, filesystems over 90% or mounted read-only, a UPS on battery, a SMART self-assessment that failed, and either TeamSpeak fault. The value column carries whichever number the check is about.

defaults.noValue: All clear — nothing is failing a health check.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(up == 0, "check", "scrape target down", "", ""), "object", "$1", "instance", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(probe_success == 0, "check", "service unreachable", "", ""), "object", "$1", "instance", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(round((probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry - time()) / 86400) < 21, "check", "TLS certificate expiring (days)", "", ""), "object", "$1", "instance", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(max by (host, zpool) (node_zfs_zpool_state{state!="online"}) == 1, "check", "ZFS pool not online", "", ""), "object", "$1", "zpool", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(nvme_critical_warning > 0, "check", "NVMe critical warning", "", ""), "object", "$1", "device", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(round(100 * nvme_available_spare_ratio) < 10, "check", "NVMe spare remaining (%)", "", ""), "object", "$1", "device", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(round(100 * (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|devtmpfs|overlay|squashfs|fuse.*|nsfs|ramfs|autofs|iso9660|proc|sysfs|cgroup.*|debugfs|tracefs|mqueue|configfs|binfmt_misc|efivarfs"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|devtmpfs|overlay|squashfs|fuse.*|nsfs|ramfs|autofs|iso9660|proc|sysfs|cgroup.*|debugfs|tracefs|mqueue|configfs|binfmt_misc|efivarfs"})) > 90, "check", "filesystem over 90% (used %)", "", ""), "object", "$1", "mountpoint", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(node_filesystem_readonly{fstype!~"tmpfs|devtmpfs|overlay|squashfs|fuse.*|nsfs|ramfs|autofs|iso9660|proc|sysfs|cgroup.*|debugfs|tracefs|mqueue|configfs|binfmt_misc|efivarfs"} == 1, "check", "filesystem read-only", "", ""), "object", "$1", "mountpoint", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(nut_ups_status{status="OB"} == 1, "check", "UPS on battery", "", ""), "object", "$1", "ups", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(smartmon_device_smart_healthy == 0 and on (host, disk) smartmon_device_smart_available == 1, "check", "SMART self-assessment failed", "", ""), "object", "$1", "disk", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(teamspeak_server_fault == 1, "check", "TeamSpeak voice down", "", ""), "object", "$1", "server", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(teamspeak_tunnel_fault == 1, "check", "TeamSpeak public path down", "", ""), "object", "$1", "server", "(.*)")

panels.title: Fleet
panels.description: Sorted by CPU. The temperature column is blank for guests on purpose: an LXC reads the node's sensors, not its own, so the number would belong to a different machine.

targets.expr: max by (host) (node_load1) / on (host) group_left () count by (host) (count by (host, cpu) (node_cpu_seconds_total))
max by (host) (node_hwmon_temp_celsius{role="hypervisor"} * on (host, chip, sensor) group_left (label) node_hwmon_sensor_label{label=~"Package id 0|Tctl"} * 9 / 5 + 32)
